meta.name: paperclip-create-agent
meta.description: Create new agents in Paperclip with governance-aware hiring. Use when you need to inspect adapter configuration options, compare existing agent configs, draft a new agent prompt/config, and submit a hire request.

copy.tagline: 在 Paperclip 中创建并提交新 agent 的 hire 请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Paperclip 平台中创建新 agent 并走审批流程。
copy.tagline_en: Create and submit hire requests for new agents in Paperclip
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create new agents in Paperclip with governance-aware hiring.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按流程创建 Paperclip agent:确认身份、查看 adapter 配置与图标,对比现有配置,按模板或基线指南草拟新 agent 的 AGENTS.md 与运行配置,提交 hire 请求并跟进审批。
howto.when: 当你说要招聘或创建 agent,或让 Claude 处理检查 adapter 配置、对比现有配置等 hire 相关任务时触发。

say.text: 对比公司现有 agent 配置,按模板起草新角色再提交审批。
say.note: 会参考模板和公司惯例生成配置。

howto.what_en: Claude runs the Paperclip hire flow: confirms identity, reads adapter config and icons, compares existing agent configs, drafts instructions/config from templates, submits the hire request, and tracks approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to hire or create an agent, or asks for hire-related tasks such as inspecting adapter configuration or comparing existing agent configs.

say_en.text: Create a CTO agent in Paperclip that reports to the CEO agent.
say_en.note: Claude drafts the config and submits a hire request.

say_en.text: List supported adapters and icons for this Paperclip, then draft an agent.
say_en.note: It fetches the adapter/icon list before drafting.

say_en.text: Compare existing configs, draft from a template, then submit the hire.
say_en.note: It follows company conventions from the template.
